title: Linking global oilseed trade networks to China's cultivated land conservation: A metacoupling perspective
title_zh: 链接全球油籽贸易网络与中国耕地保护：基于meta耦合的视角
title_primary: 链接全球油籽贸易网络与中国耕地保护：基于meta耦合的视角
title_secondary: Linking global oilseed trade networks to China's cultivated land conservation: A metacoupling perspective
authors: Min Wang, Guanghui Jiang, Xiaozhen Dong, Wenqin Ji
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: With booming global trade and deepened connectivity, China, a central player in global oilseed trade networks, has not only eased domestic supply shortages but also fundamentally reshaped global resource allocation. However, the specific impacts of this trade on the quantity and quality of cultivated land protection remain under-explored. Using complex network analysis under the metacoupling framework, this study examines the evolution of major oilseed trade patterns from 2010 to 2023 and their metacoupling impacts. During 2010–2023, the global oilseed trade network exhibited escalating structural tightness and localized clustering, evidenced by a 27.2% and 24.6% increase in network density for the S1 and S2 networks, respectively, alongside a notable transition from regional fragmentation to transcontinental integration. Crucially, China’s oilseed imports activate a "Dual-track Land Sparing Mechanism": quantitatively expanding global land savings from 116.4 to 193.1 M ha, while qualitatively buffering the domestic agricultural system by trade-driven shifts in cultivation patterns, thereby stabilizing China’s domestic cultivated land pressure index at a low safety margin (0.13–0.16). This study highlights the pivotal role of trade in balancing national food security with global sustainable land management. Future policies should focus on diversifying import sources to sustain these quantity-quality benefits against supply concentration risks.
abstract_zh: 随着全球贸易蓬勃发展和互联互通不断深化，中国作为全球油籽贸易网络的核心参与者，不仅缓解了国内供应短缺问题，也从根本上重塑了全球资源配置格局。然而，这一贸易对耕地保护数量与质量的具体影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究在元耦合框架下运用复杂网络分析，考察了2010年至2023年主要油籽贸易格局的演变及其元耦合效应。2010—2023年间，全球油籽贸易网络呈现出结构紧密度上升和局部集聚增强的特征，S1和S2网络的网络密度分别增长了27.2%和24.6%，同时呈现出从区域碎片化向跨大陆一体化转变的显著趋势。至关重要的是，中国油籽进口激活了“双轨土地节约机制”：在数量层面，全球土地节约规模从1.164亿公顷扩大至1.931亿公顷；在质量层面，通过贸易驱动的种植模式转变，对国内农业系统形成缓冲，从而将中国国内耕地压力指数稳定在较低安全区间（0.13—0.16）。本研究凸显了贸易在平衡国家粮食安全与全球可持续土地管理中的关键作用。未来政策应聚焦于进口来源多元化，以在供应集中风险下维持上述数量—质量双重效益。

title: Shock and reprice: sectoral heterogeneity in S&P 500 constituent abnormal returns around the 2026 Iran strikes
title_zh: 冲击与重新定价：2026年伊朗打击事件前后标普500成分股异常收益的行业异质性
title_primary: 冲击与重新定价：2026年伊朗打击事件前后标普500成分股异常收益的行业异质性
title_secondary: Shock and reprice: sectoral heterogeneity in S&P 500 constituent abnormal returns around the 2026 Iran strikes
authors: Khaled Alsaifi, Ahmad Bash, Fouad Jamaani, Ahmad Almutairi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This article examines the short-run equity market impact of the February 2026 US–Israeli occupation coordinated strikes on Iran using a dual-benchmark event study applied to 491 S&P 500 constituents. Relative to the S&P 500 index (internal benchmark), the aggregate cumulative average abnormal return (CAAR) over the six-trading-day post-event window [0, +5] is −1.76%, indicating that constituents underperformed the cap-weighted index on average. Relative to the EFA international benchmark (iShares MSCI EAFE ETF, excludes US), the same constituents earned a CAAR of +3.00%***, consistent with a flight-to-US-quality effect. Sector heterogeneity is pronounced: Energy firms earn +2.65%** under the internal benchmark, while Consumer Staples (−5.07%), Materials (−4.94%), Health Care (−3.59%*), Industrials (−3.21%), and Consumer Discretionary (−3.23%***) record the largest negative relative returns. Cross-sectional regressions with HC3 standard errors confirm that sector fixed effects explain 15.4% of firm-level CAR variation (joint F-test p < 0.001), compared with only 3.3% for seven firm-level characteristics. Results are robust across estimation window lengths and a six-statistic test battery.
abstract_zh: 本文采用双基准事件研究法，对2026年2月美以联合对伊朗协调打击后的短期股票市场影响进行了考察，研究对象涵盖标普500指数中的491只成分股。相对于标普500指数（内部基准），在事件后六个交易日窗口[0, +5]内，累计平均异常收益率（CAAR）为−1.76%，表明成分股平均表现逊于市值加权指数。相对于EFA国际基准（iShares MSCI EAFE ETF，不含美国），同一批成分股的CAAR为+3.00%***，与资金流向美国优质资产的效应一致。行业异质性显著：能源企业在内部基准下获得+2.65%**的正收益，而必需消费品（−5.07%）、材料（−4.94%）、医疗保健（−3.59%*）、工业（−3.21%）和非必需消费品（−3.23%***）则录得最大的负相对收益。采用HC3标准误的横截面回归证实，行业固定效应解释了企业层面CAR变异的15.4%（联合F检验p < 0.001），而七项企业层面特征仅解释了3.3%。结果在估计窗口长度变化及六项统计检验组合下均保持稳健。

title: Where and how is money spent on international migration and refugees in World Bank operational projects?
title_zh: 世界银行运营项目中国际移民与难民资金的支出地点与方式
title_primary: 世界银行运营项目中国际移民与难民资金的支出地点与方式
title_secondary: Where and how is money spent on international migration and refugees in World Bank operational projects?
authors: David McKenzie, Charlotte Müller, Pablo Acosta
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A strong evidence base has documented the many ways that international migration can bring large development benefits. Flagship reports from international organizations have long argued that countries should actively manage migration for development. How much is this evidence and rhetoric reflected in what money actually gets spent on? We analyze the World Bank portfolio of projects financed between 2014 and 2024 to see how much money is being spent on activities related to international migration and refugees, where it is being spent, and what it is being used for. We identify 160 operational projects, totaling $40 billion overall, with $15 billion in components related to migration and refugees. However, this funding is highly concentrated in a small number of countries, and over 70 percent of World Bank clients have not received a single dollar in financing for migration in a decade. Financing is almost entirely driven by projects to support refugees and displaced populations, with funding for facilitating or increasing benefits from economic (labor) migration averaging only $11 million annually. Examination of the few projects that do relate to economic migration shows efforts to develop new migration corridors, reintegrate returnees, and improve the technical and vocational training systems of sending countries to better align and certify skills with overseas demand. These cases also provide a demonstration effect of how money can be spent proactively to enhance the benefits of international mobility. The paper concludes by discussing the barriers to more project lending and potential opportunities.
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，国际移民能够带来巨大的发展效益。国际组织的旗舰报告长期以来一直主张各国应积极管理移民以促进发展。这些证据和言论在多大程度上反映于实际资金支出中？我们分析了世界银行2014年至2024年间资助的项目组合，以了解有多少资金被用于与国际移民和难民相关的活动，这些资金流向何处，以及其用途何在。我们识别出160个运营项目，总金额达400亿美元，其中与移民和难民相关的组成部分涉及150亿美元。然而，这笔资金高度集中于少数国家，超过70%的世界银行客户在过去十年中未获得任何用于移民问题的融资。融资几乎完全由支持难民和流离失所人口的项目所驱动，而用于促进或增加经济（劳务）移民效益的资金年均仅为1100万美元。对少数涉及经济移民的项目的考察显示，这些努力旨在开辟新的移民走廊、帮助回归者重新融入社会，并改善输出国的技术和职业培训体系，以更好地使技能与海外需求对接并获得认证。这些案例也展示了如何主动运用资金以增强国际流动性的效益。本文最后讨论了扩大项目贷款面临的障碍及潜在机遇。

title: DP19726 Dividing Housework between Partners: Individual Preferences and Social Norms
title_zh: 伴侣间家务分工：个人偏好与社会规范
title_primary: 伴侣间家务分工：个人偏好与社会规范
title_secondary: DP19726 Dividing Housework between Partners: Individual Preferences and Social Norms
authors: Danilo Cavapozzi, Marco Francesconi, Cheti Nicoletti
official: 官方在线 2024-11-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using UK longitudinal data on dual-earner couples, this paper estimates a model of intrahousehold housework decisions, which combines a randomized experimental framework eliciting counterfactual choices with gender norms differences across ethnicities and cohorts to identify the impacts of individual preferences and gender identity norms. Equal sharing of tasks yields greater utility for both men and women, with women disliking domestic chores as much as men. Although couples would want to use housework arrangements to compensate for differentials in labor market involvement, women end up performing a substantially larger share of housework. This is not due to specialization, rather social norms play a key role. Exposure to more egalitarian gender attitudes significantly increases the probability of choosing an equal share of housework. Were attitudes evened up to the most progressive levels observed in the sample, women doing more housework than their partners would stop to be the norm already among present-day households, except for households with children.
abstract_zh: 本文利用英国双职工夫妇的纵向数据，估计了一个家庭内家务劳动决策模型，该模型结合了引出反事实选择的随机实验框架与不同种族和世代间的性别规范差异，以识别个人偏好和性别认同规范的影响。家务劳动的平等分担对男性和女性均带来更高的效用，且女性对家务劳动的厌恶程度与男性相当。尽管夫妇倾向于利用家务安排来补偿劳动力市场参与的差异，但女性最终承担了显著更大份额的家务劳动。这并非源于专业化分工，而是社会规范发挥了关键作用。接触更平等的性别态度显著提高了选择平等分担家务的概率。若态度提升至样本中观察到的最进步水平，女性承担多于伴侣家务的现象在当今家庭中将不再成为常态，但育有子女的家庭除外。

title: The inflation rate fell but many workers’ pay cheques did not keep up
title_zh: 通胀率下降，但许多工人的工资支票未能跟上
title_primary: 通胀率下降，但许多工人的工资支票未能跟上
title_secondary: The inflation rate fell but many workers’ pay cheques did not keep up
authors: Erik Hurst, Christina Patterson
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Inflation in the US has receded from its 2022 peak. This column uses payroll records from 2016 to 2025 to show that many workers have experienced a lasting reduction in their purchasing power, and argues that the lack of systematic wage indexation in the US is central to this story. When inflation surged, most firms continued to grant familiar raises of 2% to 4%, allowing purchasing power to fall. Once inflation slowed, those raises again produced modest real wage growth but did not compensate workers for what they had already lost.
abstract_zh: 美国通胀已从2022年的峰值回落。本文利用2016年至2025年的工资记录显示，许多工人的购买力经历了持久性下降，并认为美国缺乏系统性的工资指数化机制是这一现象的核心原因。当通胀飙升时，大多数企业继续给予2%至4%的常规加薪，导致购买力下降。一旦通胀放缓，这些加薪再次带来温和的实际工资增长，但并未补偿工人此前已遭受的损失。

title: Reference‐Dependent Preferences and Sentiment‐Driven Asset Prices
title_zh: 参考依赖偏好与情绪驱动的资产价格
title_primary: 参考依赖偏好与情绪驱动的资产价格
title_secondary: Reference‐Dependent Preferences and Sentiment‐Driven Asset Prices
authors: JESS BENHABIB, ZHAORUI LI, XUEWEN LIU, PENGFEI WANG
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies asset pricing under expectations‐based reference‐dependent preferences in a general equilibrium framework. We show that reference‐dependent preferences can generate self‐fulfilling risk panics, producing sentiment‐driven asset price fluctuations through a feedback loop between current prices and perceived future downside risk—dynamics impossible under standard expected utility. The model helps explain empirical puzzles including (i) excess volatility, (ii) asymmetric volatility, (iii) asymmetric sentiment over the business cycle, (iv) excess asset price comovement, and (v) weak correlations between stock returns and economic fundamentals, alongside a sizable equity premium. Additional empirical evidence based on closed‐end fund discounts and quantitative analysis support the theory.
abstract_zh: 本文在一般均衡框架下研究基于预期参照依赖偏好的资产定价问题。我们证明，参照依赖偏好能够引发自我实现的恐慌情绪，通过当前价格与感知的未来下行风险之间的反馈循环，产生由情绪驱动的资产价格波动——这种动态在标准期望效用下是不可能出现的。该模型有助于解释一系列实证谜团，包括（i）过度波动性，（ii）非对称波动性，（iii）商业周期中的非对称情绪，（iv）资产价格的过度联动，以及（v）股票回报与经济基本面之间的弱相关性，同时伴随显著的股权溢价。基于封闭式基金折价和定量分析的额外实证证据支持了这一理论。

title: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
title_zh: 收入冲击与家庭内部动态：来自保障收入实验的证据
title_primary: 收入冲击与家庭内部动态：来自保障收入实验的证据
title_secondary: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
authors: Elizabeth Rhodes, David E. Broockman, Eva Vivalt, Patrick K. Krause, Sarah Miller 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: When an individual's income changes, it can affect their entire household. We study the intrahousehold effects of an unconditional cash transfer in which 1,000 individuals were randomly selected to receive a $1,000 per month transfer for three years, while a control group of 2,000 participants received $50 per month over the same time period. We find no effects on aggregate measures of household stability, although there is suggestive evidence of improved relationship quality and greater trust in partners among recipients in relationships. Transfers to friends and family increase, consistent with recipients sharing some of the additional income with others. There are also spillovers on the income and employment-related outcomes of other household members: household income excluding the recipient decreases by about $1,700 per year, and partners are less likely to be promoted or to move to a better job. Other household members are significantly more likely to participate in education or training, and recipients are also more likely to report someone in their household having to forgo healthcare, potentially reflecting greater engagement with the healthcare system and the identification of previously unmet needs. We observe limited changes in decision-making power or division of labor within the household. Some indicators of intimate partner violence decline, particularly for women, but reported incidence is low and most estimates do not remain statistically significant after adjustment for multiple hypothesis testing. Subgroup differences are generally imprecise, although point estimates suggest larger education and health spillover effects when the recipient is a woman. Household structure also appears to mediates the impacts of the transfers.
abstract_zh: 当个人收入发生变化时，这可能影响其整个家庭。我们研究了一项无条件现金转移支付在家庭内部的影响，其中随机选取了1000名个体，每月接受1000美元的转移支付，为期三年，而对照组2000名参与者在同一时期内每月接受50美元。我们发现，在家庭稳定性的总体指标上没有显著影响，尽管有迹象表明，处于恋爱关系中的受助者报告的关系质量有所提升，对伴侣的信任度增强。对朋友和家人的转移支付增加，这与受助者与他人分享部分额外收入的行为一致。此外，对其他家庭成员的收入和就业相关结果产生了溢出效应：不包括受助者的家庭收入每年减少约1700美元，伴侣晋升或跳槽至更好工作的可能性降低。其他家庭成员参与教育或培训的可能性显著增加，同时受助者更可能报告家中有人不得不放弃医疗服务，这可能反映了对医疗系统更深的参与及对先前未满足需求的识别。我们观察到家庭内部决策权或劳动分工的变化有限。一些亲密伴侣暴力的指标有所下降，尤其是对女性而言，但报告的发生率较低，且多数估计值在多重假设检验调整后不再具有统计显著性。亚组差异通常不精确，尽管点估计表明，当受助者为女性时，教育和健康溢出效应更大。家庭结构似乎也调节了转移支付的影响。

title: Creating Better-Paid Jobs Thanks to Regional Trade Agreements? Evidence from Indonesia
title_zh: 区域贸易协定能否创造更高薪酬的就业机会？来自印度尼西亚的证据
title_primary: 区域贸易协定能否创造更高薪酬的就业机会？来自印度尼西亚的证据
title_secondary: Creating Better-Paid Jobs Thanks to Regional Trade Agreements? Evidence from Indonesia
authors: Esther Delesalle, Florian Mayneris, William Parienté, Gonzague Vannoorenberghe, Rafael Dix-Carneiro 等
official: 官方在线 2025-01-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this study, we examine the impact of the ASEAN-China Free Trade Agreement (ACFTA) on the likelihood of becoming a wage worker in Indonesia, which serves as a proxy for better paid employment in the Indonesian context. Our findings suggest that reductions in import and export tariffs did not, on average, increase the probability of becoming a wage worker, except among those with more than a primary education (25% of the working-age population). The estimated impact on various subgroups and sectors appears to vary considerably across regions, being stronger in Java, the most densely populated and economically dynamic island. In line with these limited average effects at worker level, we also find no significant changes in employment or value added in large and medium-sized manufacturing firms, which are the main providers of salaried jobs. Our results suggest that, if anything, the ACFTA had a regressive impact on access to better-paying jobs.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了东盟-中国自由贸易协定（ACFTA）对印度尼西亚成为工资劳动者可能性的影响，这一指标在印尼背景下被视为获得更高薪酬就业的代理变量。我们的研究结果表明，平均而言，进出口关税的削减并未提高成为工资劳动者的概率，除非是那些接受过小学以上教育的人群（占劳动年龄人口的25%）。对各子群体和部门的影响估计在不同地区间差异显著，在爪哇岛——人口最密集且经济最具活力的岛屿——影响更为明显。与工人层面这些有限的平均效应相一致，我们也未发现大中型制造业企业（这些企业是带薪岗位的主要提供者）在就业或附加值方面发生显著变化。我们的研究结果表明，若要说有何影响，ACFTA对获得更高薪酬工作的机会产生了倒退性影响。

title: Leverage constraints and bank monitoring: Bank regulation versus monetary policy
title_zh: 杠杆约束与银行监督：银行监管与货币政策
title_primary: 杠杆约束与银行监督：银行监管与货币政策
title_secondary: Leverage constraints and bank monitoring: Bank regulation versus monetary policy
authors: Florian Böser, Hans Gersbach, Sebastian Zelzner
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Bank leverage constraints can arise from regulatory capital requirements or from central bank collateral requirements in reserve lending. We compare these two policy channels within the so-called “bank money creation” approach. We show that monetary policy via collateral requirements leads to a novel and unique collateral leverage channel. Through this channel, banks facing liquidity constraints can expand loan supply and deposit issuance by raising the collateral value of their loans, which they achieve through tighter loan monitoring. The collateral leverage channel can improve welfare beyond standard bank capital regulation and inform the design of central bank collateral frameworks.
abstract_zh: 银行杠杆约束可能源于监管资本要求，或中央银行在储备贷款中的抵押品要求。我们在所谓的“银行货币创造”框架内比较这两种政策渠道。我们表明，通过抵押品要求实施的货币政策引致了一个新颖且独特的抵押品杠杆渠道。通过这一渠道，面临流动性约束的银行可以通过提高其贷款的抵押品价值来扩大贷款供给和存款发行，而这通过更严格的贷款监控实现。抵押品杠杆渠道能在标准银行资本监管之外增进福利，并为中央银行抵押品框架的设计提供参考。

title: Training time, robots and technological unemployment
title_zh: 训练时间、机器人及技术性失业
title_primary: 训练时间、机器人及技术性失业
title_secondary: Training time, robots and technological unemployment
authors: Fenicia Cossu, Alessio Moro, Michelle Petersen Rendall
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We document that labor training requirements for high-skilled occupations increased in the U.S. from 2006 to 2019. These greater training requirements reduce the extent to which workers displaced from shrinking occupations can relocate to expanding (high-skilled) occupations, thus potentially affecting both the equilibrium occupational structure and the unemployment level. We build a quantitative model in which labor is displaced by task-replacing technological change embodied in robots (“tasks shock”) and the extent of occupational switching depends on the destination occupations’ training requirements. We find that: (i) task-displacing technological change increases steady-state unemployment, but it reduces unemployment along the transition; (ii) in contrast, a comparable shock to capital embodied technological change produces larger unemployment rates with respect to the tasks shock, both in the transition and the steady state; and (iii) greater training requirements in high-skilled occupations increase steady-state unemployment and affect the occupational structure along the transition, but the shape of their effect depends on the size of the technological shock
abstract_zh: 我们记录到，2006年至2019年间，美国高技能职业的劳动力培训要求有所提高。这些更高的培训要求降低了因萎缩职业而失业的工人向扩张（高技能）职业转移的程度，从而可能同时影响均衡职业结构和失业水平。我们构建了一个定量模型，其中劳动力因体现于机器人中的任务替代型技术变革（“任务冲击”）而失业，且职业转换的程度取决于目标职业的培训要求。我们发现：（i）任务替代型技术变革提高了稳态失业率，但在转型过程中降低了失业率；（ii）相比之下，与任务冲击相当规模的资本体现型技术变革冲击，在转型期和稳态下均产生更高的失业率；（iii）高技能职业中更高的培训要求提高了稳态失业率，并影响转型期间的职业结构，但其影响形态取决于技术冲击的规模。

abstract: This paper examines how import tariffs by a developed country (the North) and a developing country (the South) affect innovation and foreign direct investment (FDI) using a quality ladder model. We show that a Northern import tariff raises the relative wage of Northern labor, but impedes innovation and FDI. This may worsen Northern welfare. By contrast, a Southern import tariff raises the relative wage of Southern labor and promotes innovation and FDI. This can improve Southern welfare. These imply that the South has a stronger incentive than the North to impose an import tariff, which is consistent with actual observation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用质量阶梯模型，研究了发达国家（北方）与发展中国家（南方）的进口关税如何影响创新与外商直接投资（FDI）。研究表明，北方进口关税会提高北方劳动力的相对工资，但抑制创新与FDI，这可能损害北方福利。相比之下，南方进口关税会提高南方劳动力的相对工资，并促进创新与FDI，从而改善南方福利。这意味着南方比北方更有动机征收进口关税，这与实际观察结果一致。

title: Early Life Healthcare Access and Later-life Mortality: Evidence Using Openings of County Health Departments

title_primary: 早期医疗保健可及性与晚年死亡率：基于县级卫生部门设立的证据

authors: Hamid Noghanibehambari, Jason Fletcher
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the long-term effects of early-life exposure to county health departments (CHDs), a public health initiative aimed at providing affordable healthcare access to disadvantaged and underserved areas during the early decades of the 20th century, on later-life longevity. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census and implement a difference-in-differences estimation strategy to compare the longevity of individuals exposed at different ages to the county-specific year of CHD establishment. We find that exposure to a CHD opening in the county of birth during fetal development and early years of life is associated with a 1-4-month increase in longevity. We observe considerable heterogeneity in the results, such that the effects are more concentrated among non-white individuals and individuals with lower-educated parents. Contemporaneous fertility and infant mortality data suggest reductions in infant mortality rates and increases in birth rates following CHD openings. Additionally, we find significant improvements in educational attainment, socioeconomic status, and income in early adulthood. We argue that enhancements in the fetal environment, improved fetal survival, and better early life health capital resulting from CHD exposure contribute to improvements in human capital during adulthood, with potential implications for later-life longevity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了早期接触县级卫生部门（CHDs）对晚年寿命的长期影响。CHDs是20世纪早期旨在为弱势和医疗服务不足地区提供可负担医疗服务的公共卫生举措。我们利用与1940年人口普查相关联的社会保障管理局死亡记录，并采用双重差分估计策略，比较不同年龄接触县级卫生部门设立年份的个体的寿命差异。研究发现，在胎儿发育期和生命早期接触出生县CHD的设立与寿命延长1-4个月相关。结果存在显著异质性，非白人个体及父母教育水平较低的个体受影响更为集中。同期生育率和婴儿死亡率数据显示，CHD设立后婴儿死亡率下降、出生率上升。此外，我们发现早期成年期的教育程度、社会经济地位和收入均有显著改善。我们认为，CHD接触带来的胎儿环境改善、胎儿存活率提升及早期健康资本积累，促进了成年期人力资本提升，并对晚年寿命产生潜在影响。

title: Network Effects, Standardization, and the Internet: What Have We Learned From The DVD Vs. DIVX Battle?
title_zh: 网络效应、标准化与互联网：从DVD与DIVX之争中我们学到了什么？

authors: Neil Gandal, David Dranove
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Two important welfare implications of network effects are that (1) market forces often result in suboptimal standardization, that is, left alone the market may fail to achieve standardization when it is socially desirable and (2) even if the market settles on a standard, the chosen standard may be inferior. Some policy makers have interpreted these results to mean that when there are strong network effects, regulators should play an active role in setting standards. Others have urged regulators not to intervene despite the presence of network effects, unless owners of proprietary standards take strategic actions to influence the adoption decisions of consumers. One action that has raised regulatory (antitrust) concerns is strategic product preannouncements or 'vaporware'. In this paper, we empirically test for network effects and vaporware effects in the DVD market and examine the role played by the Internet.
abstract_zh: 网络效应的两个重要福利含义是：（1）市场力量往往导致次优标准化，即若放任市场自行发展，当标准化具有社会合意性时，市场可能无法实现标准化；（2）即使市场最终确立了某种标准，所选标准也可能并非最优。部分政策制定者将这些结论解读为：当存在强网络效应时，监管机构应在标准制定中发挥积极作用。另一些政策制定者则主张，即便存在网络效应，除非专有标准所有者采取战略性行动影响消费者的采纳决策，否则监管机构不应干预。其中引发监管（反垄断）关注的一种行为是战略性产品预发布或"雾件"。本文通过实证检验DVD市场中的网络效应与雾件效应，并考察互联网在其中发挥的作用。

title: Weak* dominance

title_primary: 弱*占优

authors: Xiao Luo, Yongchuan Qiao
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a new dominance notion in strategic games—weak* dominance—that reflects the idea of cautious* rationality, whereby a rational player believes that each opponent’s individual actions are played with positive probabilities. In this paper, we show that an action is weakly* dominated if, and only if, it is not a best response to any marginally full-support conjecture. We characterize Gul’s (1996) notion of perfect τ-rationalizability through an iterative procedure ( S ∞ W * ): removing all weakly* dominated actions in the first round, and then removing only strictly dominated actions in the subsequent rounds. Moreover, we provide epistemic foundations for the iterative procedure in a lexicographic type structure model.
abstract_zh: 我们提出战略博弈中的一种新支配概念——弱*支配，它体现了谨慎*理性的思想，即理性玩家相信每个对手的个体行动以正概率被采取。本文证明，一个行动是弱*支配的，当且仅当它不是对任何边际全支持猜想的的最佳回应。我们通过迭代程序（S∞W*）刻画了Gul（1996）的完美τ-理性化概念：首轮移除所有弱*支配行动，随后各轮仅移除严格支配行动。此外，我们在词典序类型结构模型中为该迭代程序提供了认知基础。

abstract: This paper explores whether and why a maternal child penalty to earnings would emerge even without changes in employment and hours worked. Using a matched event study design, we trace monthly changes in determinants of wages (job performance, human capital accumulation, and promotions). Data come from a usefully unusual setting with required multiyear employment and detailed personnel data: the US Marine Corps. Mothers’ job performance initially declines, and gaps in promotion grow through 24 months postbirth. Fathers’ physical fitness performance drops somewhat but recovers. These patterns lead mothers to earn relatively lower wages, even absent changes in employment postbirth.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了即使在就业和工作时长不变的情况下，母亲因育儿导致的收入惩罚是否会出现及其成因。通过匹配事件研究设计，我们追踪了工资决定因素（工作表现、人力资本积累和晋升）的月度变化。数据来源于一个具有特殊研究价值的场景——美国海军陆战队，该场景要求多年连续就业并提供详细人事数据。研究发现，母亲的工作表现最初出现下降，且晋升差距在产后24个月内持续扩大。父亲的身体素质表现虽有短暂下滑但随后恢复。这些模式导致母亲在产后即使就业状态未变，其相对工资水平仍有所降低。

abstract: We conduct survey experiments to test how the design of scientific grants— the money and time awarded—can be used to manage researchers. On average, researchers are relatively unwilling to trade o! money for time when choosing among grants. However, there is significant heterogeneity in researchers’ preferences. Conditional on receiving a grant, di!erent designs cause only minor changes in researchers’ plans for how they would use the funding. Marginal changes in grant design are more relevant for selection e!ects (funders’ ability to attract certain researchers) than treatment e!ects (funders’ ability to change researchers’ strategies).
abstract_zh: 我们通过调查实验检验科研资助的设计——即所授予的资金与时间——如何用于管理研究人员。平均而言，研究人员在选择资助时相对不愿以金钱换取时间。然而，研究人员的偏好存在显著异质性。在获得资助的条件下，不同的设计仅对研究人员如何使用资金的计划产生微小变化。资助设计的边际变化对选择效应（资助方吸引特定研究人员的能力）的影响大于处理效应（资助方改变研究人员策略的能力）。

abstract: Using novel data from the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking, we examine how labor market tightness affects workers’ job quality. We estimate that a 10 percent increase in job vacancies not only increases the probability of changing jobs, it yields an 11–18 percent increase in the (unconditional) probability of switching to a better job overall, and one with greater pay and benefits, interest in the work, and advancement opportunities. Because tight labor markets improve both worker pay and job amenities in roughly the same proportion, their benefits to workers are underestimated when based on pay alone.

title: How Should Central Banks Respond to Commodity Price Shocks? Optimal Monetary and Exchange Rate Frameworks for Commodity-Exposed Economies

authors: Thomas Drechsel, Michael McLeay, Silvana Tenreyro, Enrico D. Turri
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口程度。我们构建了一个兼具灵活性与可操作性的模型经济体，该模型包含商品进出口部门，且国际金融条件可能随商品周期变化，并在存在价格与工资粘性的条件下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会"忽略"商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与部分早期研究发现及政策实践（仅"忽略"直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，钉住汇率制度能提升福利水平，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴市场与发展中经济体，金融条件与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战——这要求政策具备足够公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。

abstract: Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel, we provide a comprehensive investigation of the relationship between workplace co-determination in the form of works councils and income satisfaction. Controlling for a wide range of individual, job-related, and firm-level characteristics in OLS and fixed effects specifications, we observe that employees working in establishments with a works council report significantly higher income satisfaction compared to their counterparts in non-co-determined firms. Rank in the income distribution, perceived fairness of the wage, and working conditions emerge as quantitatively relevant factors in explaining the positive correlation.
abstract_zh: 基于德国社会经济面板数据，本文全面考察了以企业职工委员会为形式的职场共同决策与收入满意度之间的关系。在控制个体、岗位及企业层面广泛特征变量的OLS与固定效应模型中，我们发现：相较于非共同决策企业，设有职工委员会企业的员工报告的收入满意度显著更高。收入分配位次、工资公平感知及工作条件是解释这一正向关联的关键量化因素。

title: Hold-up in the Absence of Individual Rationality: Asymptotic Efficiency and Gradualism
title_zh: 缺乏个体理性下的敲竹杠问题：渐近效率与渐进主义
title_primary: 缺乏个体理性下的敲竹杠问题：渐近效率与渐进主义
title_secondary: Hold-up in the Absence of Individual Rationality: Asymptotic Efficiency and Gradualism
authors: Prabal Roy Chowdhury, Kunal Sengupta
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The hold-up problem has given rise to a large and influential literature. We consider a bilateral hold-up problem where bargaining power is asymmetrically distributed among the agents, in particular investing at the efficient level is not “individually rational” for one of the agents. We demonstrate that in the presence of a rich natural setup – that allows for dynamics in transfers, investments and negotiations – there exist subgame perfect equilibria that achieve asymptotic efficiency. This is true both when investments by the two agents are substitutes, as well as when these are complements. Moreover, implementation requires gradualism, with sequential investments and transfers over several periods.
abstract_zh: 敲竹杠问题催生了一大批具有影响力的文献。我们考虑一个双边敲竹杠问题，其中议价能力在代理人之间不对称分布，特别是，对于其中一方代理人而言，以有效水平进行投资并非“个体理性”的。我们证明，在一个丰富的自然设定下——该设定允许转移支付、投资和谈判具有动态性——存在能够实现渐近效率的子博弈完美均衡。这一结论在双方投资为替代品时成立，在投资为互补品时同样成立。此外，实施过程需要渐进性，即投资和转移支付需在多个时期内顺序进行。

title: Willing but unable to pay? Gender, preferences, resources, and tax compliance
title_zh: 愿意但无力支付？性别、偏好、资源与税收遵从
title_primary: 愿意但无力支付？性别、偏好、资源与税收遵从
title_secondary: Willing but unable to pay? Gender, preferences, resources, and tax compliance
authors: Andrea Lopez-Luzuriaga, Carlos Scartascini
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The existing literature shows that women are generally more likely than men to pay taxes. However, there is less consensus on gendered responses to interventions designed to boost compliance among non-payers, and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we exploit a field experiment designed to increase property tax compliance to investigate this gender disparity. Because female- and male-led households differ along many dimensions, including preferences, household structure, and economic resources, we interpret the female–male contrast as the joint product of these channels rather than the effect of gender alone. Within this framing, the cross-sectional baseline gap in compliance is descriptive, while the within-gender treatment effects of the experimental messages are causally identified by random assignment. Our findings confirm that taxpayers in female-led households are more diligent in paying taxes than those in male-led households at baseline. Notably, while receiving a deterrence letter encourages women to pay earlier, it does not increase their overall compliance; men, in contrast, show a marked improvement in overall compliance upon receiving the same letter. We also find that the size of the tax bill influences women’s compliance behavior (the likelihood of payment after treatment rises significantly for smaller tax bills) but has no similar effect on men. Survey data targeted at the same population suggest that, although women may be more motivated to pay (they perceive higher enforcement risk and exhibit higher tax morale) they also face tighter liquidity constraints, lower and less stable income, and a stronger perception that the tax is excessive. These patterns are consistent with a simple analytical model that links compliance to tax morale, risk aversion, and budget constraints, and in which liquidity-constrained taxpayers remain at a corner solution unresponsive to enforcement messages. The findings highlight how tax policies and enforcement procedures can exacerbate post-tax income inequality between genders, particularly in low-enforcement contexts where the tax base is weakly correlated with current income.
abstract_zh: 现有文献表明，女性通常比男性更倾向于纳税。然而，关于旨在提高未缴税者合规性的干预措施是否存在性别差异反应，学界尚未达成共识，其潜在机制仍不明确。本研究利用一项旨在提高房产税合规性的实地实验，探究这一性别差异。由于女性主导家庭与男性主导家庭在偏好、家庭结构及经济资源等多个维度存在差异，我们将男女对比解读为这些渠道共同作用的结果，而非单纯性别效应。在此框架下，横截面基线合规差距属于描述性分析，而实验信息在性别内部的处理效应则通过随机分配实现因果识别。研究结果证实，在基线水平上，女性主导家庭的纳税人比男性主导家庭更勤于纳税。值得注意的是，虽然收到威慑信函会促使女性提前缴税，但并未提高其整体合规率；而男性在收到相同信函后，整体合规率显著提升。我们还发现，税额大小影响女性的合规行为（小额税单处理后支付概率显著上升），但对男性无类似效应。针对同一人群的调查数据表明，尽管女性可能更有纳税动机（她们感知到更高的执法风险并表现出更强的纳税道德），但同时也面临更紧的流动性约束、更低且不稳定的收入，以及更强烈的税负过重感知。这些模式与一个将合规性关联至纳税道德、风险规避及预算约束的简单分析模型一致，在该模型中，受流动性约束的纳税人处于角点解状态，对执法信息无反应。研究结果凸显了税收政策与执法程序如何加剧性别间的税后收入不平等，尤其是在税基与当前收入弱相关的低执法环境中。

title: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
title_zh: 自制或外购决策与数据共享
title_primary: 自制或外购决策与数据共享
title_secondary: Make or Buy Decisions and Data Sharing
authors: Antoine Dubus, Patrick Legros
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Firms can share data to discover potential synergies between their data sets and algorithms, eventually leading to more efficient mergers and acquisitions (M&A) decisions. However, data sharing also modifies the competitive balance when firms do not merge, and a company may be reluctant to share data with potential rivals. Under general conditions, we show that firms benefit from (partially) sharing data. By doing so, they can merge conditionally based on high synergies. Compared to a laissez‐faire situation, the presence of a regulator allowing or refusing the M&A may increase or decrease data sharing, with a concomitant increase or decrease in consumer surplus. Hence, regulation can reduce the surplus of consumers it is willing to protect. We revisit the Google/Fitbit acquisition through the lens of this interplay between strategic data sharing and antitrust policy.
abstract_zh: 企业可以通过共享数据来发现其数据集与算法之间的潜在协同效应，最终促成更高效的并购决策。然而，当企业未进行合并时，数据共享也会改变竞争格局，导致企业可能不愿与潜在竞争对手共享数据。在一般条件下，我们证明企业能从（部分）数据共享中获益。通过这种方式，它们可以基于高协同效应有条件地实施合并。与放任自流的情形相比，允许或拒绝并购的监管机构的存在可能增加或减少数据共享，并随之带来消费者剩余的增加或减少。因此，监管可能反而会降低其本意要保护的消费者剩余。我们通过战略数据共享与反垄断政策之间的这种互动关系，重新审视了谷歌/飞特必收购案。

title: Data Portability and Interoperability Between Digital Platforms
title_zh: 数字平台间的数据可携性与互操作性
title_primary: 数字平台间的数据可携性与互操作性
title_secondary: Data Portability and Interoperability Between Digital Platforms
authors: Jeong‐Yoo Kim
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the effects of regulation requiring data portability and interoperability in digital platform competition. Data portability and interoperability have the effect of eliminating switching costs between platforms and enlarging network externalities but increasing the risk of data breaches. We show that in the absence of data breaches, the regulation improves welfare by reducing switching costs and increasing network benefits. We also show that with data breach accidents, ensuring data portability and interoperability increases the accident probability, but the joint and several liability with negligence standards can attain the social optimum by inducing firms to take efficient care to prevent accidents.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了数字平台竞争中要求数据可携带性和互操作性的监管效应。数据可携带性和互操作性具有消除平台间转换成本并扩大网络外部性的效果，但同时也增加了数据泄露的风险。我们证明，在没有数据泄露的情况下，该监管通过降低转换成本和增加网络效益来提升社会福利。我们还证明，在发生数据泄露事故的情况下，确保数据可携带性和互操作性会增加事故概率，但结合过失标准的连带责任能够通过促使企业采取有效预防措施来达到社会最优状态。

title: Ambiguity Aversion, Portfolio Choice, and Life Expectancy
title_zh: 模糊厌恶、投资组合选择与预期寿命
title_primary: 模糊厌恶、投资组合选择与预期寿命
title_secondary: Ambiguity Aversion, Portfolio Choice, and Life Expectancy
authors: Alistair Macaulay, Chenchuan Shi
official: 官方在线 2026-04-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: An earlier version of this paper was circulated under the title “Ambiguity Averse Portfolio Choices in an Aging Population.”
abstract_zh: 本文早期版本曾以“老龄化人口中的模糊厌恶投资组合选择”为题流传。

title: River-sharing problem with floods
title_zh: 洪水条件下的河流共享问题
title_primary: 洪水条件下的河流共享问题
title_secondary: River-sharing problem with floods
authors: Takayuki Oishi, Tomoya Tajika
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: International river basins are prone to droughts in some countries and floods in others. Water inflows from upstream neighbors benefit drought-stricken countries but harm flood-stricken countries. As a generalization of two existing river-sharing models (Ambec and Ehlers, 2008; Ambec and Sprumont, 2002), which do not capture the disutility of water inflow, we formulate the river-sharing problem with floods. We provide two characterizations of benefit-function profiles for which the downstream incremental distribution is the unique welfare distribution that satisfies both the upper and lower welfare bounds of river basin countries. We also propose a strategic bargaining process that yields this welfare distribution as a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 国际河流流域中，部分国家易遭受干旱，而另一些国家则面临洪涝灾害。上游邻国的来水对遭受干旱的国家有益，却对受洪灾影响的国家造成损害。作为对现有两个河流共享模型（Ambec和Ehlers，2008；Ambec和Sprumont，2002）的推广，这些模型未考虑来水带来的负效用，我们构建了包含洪灾情形的河流共享问题。我们给出了效益函数谱系的两种特征刻画，在此条件下，下游增量分配是唯一同时满足流域国家上、下福利界限的福利分配方案。此外，我们提出了一种策略性谈判过程，该过程以唯一子博弈完美均衡的形式实现这一福利分配。

title: Optimally informative rankings and consumer search
title_zh: 最优信息量排名与消费者搜索
title_primary: 最优信息量排名与消费者搜索
title_secondary: Optimally informative rankings and consumer search
authors: Maarten C.W. Janssen, Thomas Jungbauer, Marcel Preuss, Cole Williams
official: 官方在线 2026-03-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the optimal information policy of an online platform (or multi-product firm) when ranking products in response to a consumer search query. The informativeness of rankings ranges from full information to full obfuscation, and consumers learn their match values with the products by engaging in costly sequential search. Invoking continuous match value distributions allows us to establish a novel result about consumer search. While consumers buy products with high match values and continue searching when they encounter low match values, they abort search without buying a product for intermediate ones. For a large class of distributions, the optimal strategy of a platform maximizing the probability of the consumer buying a product is to provide either full information or the smallest amount of information subject to the constraint that the consumer starts searching. As a result, platform and consumer welfare are either fully aligned or at odds with each other.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在线平台（或多产品企业）在回应消费者搜索查询时对产品进行排序的最优信息政策。排序的信息含量范围从完全信息到完全混淆，消费者通过进行有成本的序贯搜索来了解其与产品的匹配值。利用连续匹配值分布，我们得以建立关于消费者搜索的新颖结论。消费者在遇到高匹配值时购买产品，在遇到低匹配值时继续搜索，而在遇到中等匹配值时则中止搜索且不购买任何产品。对于一大类分布而言，平台最大化消费者购买产品概率的最优策略是提供完全信息，或在消费者开始搜索的约束下提供最少量的信息。因此，平台与消费者福利要么完全一致，要么相互对立。

title: Household migration in response to climate and severe weather: Heterogeneous sorting and the rural–urban divide
title_zh: 家庭迁移对气候与极端天气的响应：异质性分类与城乡差异
title_primary: 家庭迁移对气候与极端天气的响应：异质性分类与城乡差异
title_secondary: Household migration in response to climate and severe weather: Heterogeneous sorting and the rural–urban divide
authors: Jarron VanCeylon, Richard T. Melstrom
official: 官方在线 2025-09-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates rural–urban climate disparities by analyzing household moves in response to severe weather events along the U.S. East Coast. Using a longitudinal sorting model, we assess migration following Federal Emergency Management Agency disaster declarations and find that household willingness to pay to avoid disasters differs between urban and rural areas. Specifically, households are willing to pay approximately $925 to avoid urban areas affected by hurricanes and $1072 to avoid rural areas affected by floods. Additionally, we find partial evidence that migration responses differ between White and Black/Hispanic households. These findings highlight the importance of understanding climate adaptation disparities across racial and ethnic groups, providing insights into equitable disaster aid and climate resilience strategies.
abstract_zh: 本文通过分析美国东海岸家庭对极端天气事件的迁移反应，探讨城乡气候差异。利用纵向排序模型，我们评估了联邦紧急事务管理局灾害声明后的迁移行为，发现家庭为避免灾害的支付意愿在城乡之间存在差异。具体而言，家庭愿意支付约925美元以避免受飓风影响的城市地区，以及约1072美元以避免受洪水影响的农村地区。此外，我们发现有部分证据表明，白人与黑人/西班牙裔家庭的迁移反应存在差异。这些发现凸显了理解不同种族和民族群体间气候适应差异的重要性，为公平的灾害援助和气候韧性策略提供了见解。

title: A transparent index of well being accounting for mortality: Poverty Adjusted Life Expectancy.
title_zh: 考虑死亡率的透明福祉指数：贫困调整预期寿命
title_primary: 考虑死亡率的透明福祉指数：贫困调整预期寿命
title_secondary: A transparent index of well being accounting for mortality: Poverty Adjusted Life Expectancy.
authors: Benoit Decerf, Guilhem Cassan, Jean-Marie Baland
official: 官方在线 2023-04-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Poverty and mortality are the two major sources of well-being losses. We propose new summary indicators of well-being that account for mortality while being (i) conceptually sound, (ii) easily interpretable and implementable and (iii) sensitive to the distribution of well-being. Our main indicator is the poverty-adjusted life expectancy index. Following the expected life-cycle utility approach a la Harsanyi, it is based on a single normative parameter that transparently captures the trade-off between poverty and mortality. Empirically, we compare countries over time and focus on these situations in which mortality is in conflict with poverty. Once we assume that being poor is (at least weakly) preferable to being dead, we find that about a third of these conflicting comparisons can be unambiguously ranked by the poverty-adjusted life expectancy index. Finally, this indicator naturally defines a new and simple index of multidimensional poverty, the expected deprivation index, which also accounts for unequal lifespans.
abstract_zh: 贫困与死亡率是福祉损失的两大主要来源。我们提出了新的福祉综合指标，该指标在考虑死亡率的同时，具备以下特征：（i）概念严谨，（ii）易于解释与实施，（iii）对福祉分布具有敏感性。我们的核心指标是贫困调整预期寿命指数。遵循哈萨尼式的预期生命周期效用方法，该指数基于单一规范性参数，能够透明地反映贫困与死亡率之间的权衡关系。在实证层面，我们通过跨国时间序列比较，聚焦于死亡率与贫困存在冲突的情形。一旦假设贫困状态（至少弱）优于死亡状态，我们发现约三分之一的此类冲突比较可通过贫困调整预期寿命指数获得明确排序。最后，该指标自然衍生出一个新颖且简洁的多维贫困指数——预期剥夺指数，该指数同样考虑了寿命不平等问题。
